purpose: Reconcile each original reference nodeid with current collected tests and documented behavior. This is not a test execution report.

MAPPED requires specific equivalent assertions or an evidenced rename/parameterization. Nearby names and shared keywords are not sufficient.
SUPERSEDED_BY_SPEC records an incompatible old contract plus the current specification and replacement behavior; it is not a passing equivalent test.
UNRESOLVED preserves deleted input/edge-case/performance/CI configuration assertions without demonstrated equivalent coverage.
new_ids on superseded entries identify replacement-policy evidence. For unresolved entries, related tests are evidence only and are not claimed as mappings.
Added current nodeids remain additions even when they also replace an old name. Counts of mappings must not be added to execution counts.
